import importlib.util,sys,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('weak_membership_audit',Path('scripts/audit_ba_geometry_bins.py'))
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);sys.modules[s.name]=m;s.loader.exec_module(m)
source=Path('/home/sasaki/datasets/openloris/corridor1-1-m8-dense256x2-1k-control-v1/rig-legacy-cap256/model')
rig=Path('/home/sasaki/datasets/openloris/corridor1-1-m8-visloc-rig/tier-1000/rig-manifest.txt')
pre=m._preflight_model(source);m._require_frozen_counts(pre,'initial')
model=m._PUBLISH.parse_model(source)
centres={}
for im in model.images:
    centres[im.image_id]=np.linalg.solve(np.array(m._AUDIT.rotation(im.q)),-np.array(im.t))
selected=[];selected_obs=0;max_difference=0.
for p in model.points:
    cs=[centres[i] for i,_ in p.track]
    rays=np.array([np.array(p.xyz)-c for c in cs])
    rays/=np.linalg.norm(rays,axis=1)[:,None]
    smallest=1.
    for i in range(1,len(rays)):
        smallest=min(smallest,float(np.min(np.abs(rays[:i]@rays[i]))))
    angle=math.degrees(math.acos(max(0.,min(1.,smallest))))
    other=m._track_angle(p.xyz,cs)
    max_difference=max(max_difference,abs(angle-other))
    assert (angle<.1)==(other<.1)
    if angle<.1:
        selected.append(p.point_id);selected_obs+=len(p.track)
selected.sort();assert len(selected)==39 and selected_obs==949
hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((source/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('cameras.txt','images.txt','points3D.txt')}
hashes['rig-manifest']=hashlib.sha256(rig.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
d=hashlib.sha256()
for name in ('cameras.txt','images.txt','points3D.txt','rig-manifest'):
    d.update(name.encode()+bytes([0])+hashes[name].encode()+bytes([255]))
combined=d.hexdigest();assert combined=='ecb825c37e2aed47adef6b20e0d362544c56e37238861d5bcf80ed80cb915829',combined
m._verify_preflight(source,pre)
print(json.dumps({'ids':selected,'count':len(selected),'observations':selected_obs,'source_sha256':combined,'source_file_hashes':hashes,'independent_membership_match':True,'max_pair_angle_difference_degrees':max_difference},sort_keys=True))
